title: Family-Friendly Ways to Celebrate Whole Grains Month
summary: Celebrate Whole Grains Month with family-friendly kitchen activities, whole grain tips, a homemade yogurt dill ranch recipe and ideas for meaningful mealtime connection.

September often brings a lot of excitement and a fresh sense of routine. Between back-to-school schedules, fall sports and busy weekday evenings, finding time to connect feels more important than ever. It also shares the spotlight with[Whole Grains Month](https://wholegrainscouncil.org/get-involved/celebrate-whole-grains-month-september) , an annual campaign led by the[Whole Grains Council](https://wholegrainscouncil.org/) that highlights the nutritional benefits of whole grains and provides resources to help families incorporate them into everyday lifestyles.


Before we get to cooking, it helps to know what makes a grain “whole.” Whole grains contain the entire seed or kernel of a plant in its whole form. Meaning, these grains have the same proportions as when they were growing in a field. All the nutrient-rich parts of the plant, like the bran, germ and endosperm, are intact and provide the essential nutrients of fiber, potassium, iron and B-vitamins.


One simple way to identify whole grains when shopping is to read the ingredient list. Look for the word “whole” before a grain’s name and look for other words like “brown rice,” “cracked wheat” and “oats.” You may also notice the distinctive golden-yellow[Whole Grain Stamp](https://wholegrainscouncil.org/whole-grain-stamp) on certain products. Created by the Whole Grains Council, the stamp helps consumers quickly identify foods that contain meaningful amounts of whole grains. That’s why we’re excited that the packaging for[Tyson® Mega Dino Nuggets](https://www.tyson.com/products/nuggets-patties/00023700060648) will begin featuring the stamp this month, giving families another easy way to spot products that include whole grains.


______________


Looking for ways to participate in Whole Grains Month? Here are three simple ideas to try at home with the whole family.


##### **Try a New Whole Grain Favorite Together**


Introducing new foods and new recipes can sometimes be a challenge with families, but making it a family activity could help ease any hesitation. For tonight’s menu, pair Tyson® Mega Dino Nuggets *(9g whole grains per serving)* with your family’s favorite vegetables and this simple homemade Yogurt Dill Ranch Dip for a fun and flavorful mealtime combo.


##### **Build Skills in the Kitchen**


Cooking together can help build confidence, encourage independence and create opportunities to connect. Whether you’re teaching younger children basic tasks or helping teens build new skills, everyone can play a role in preparing a meal.


Here are a few simple ways to get everyone involved:


- **Go on an ingredient hunt:** Search the refrigerator or pantry for ingredients before cooking begins.


- **Master measurements:** Practice measuring ingredients using teaspoons, tablespoons and measuring cups.


- **Mix it up:** Stirring ingredients is an easy task for family members of all ages to help with.


- **Count and cook:** Count out the perfect servings and portion plates for each family member’s meal.


- **Set the table:** Let creativity take shape by having someone arrange the table, add plates and napkins and take drink orders.


- **Join the clean team:** Assign or rotate tasks like clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and wiping the table.


Small kitchen responsibilities can help build confidence and make meal preparation feel like a shared effort.


##### **Enjoy a Mega Mealtime Together**


As you sit down with your Tyson® Mega Dino Nugget-inspired meal, take a moment to appreciate the time spent together.[Research from the Family Meals Movement](https://www.fmi.org/family-meals-movement/#research) suggests that shared meals can help strengthen communication, build family connections and create positive routines.


Make your dinner time even more fun by adding some conversation starters. You can print[table talk placemats](https://www.fmi.org/family-meals/toolkits/table-talk-placemats) for great talking prompts from *The Family Meals Movement* or create your own prompts and take turns asking and answering.


______________


As your family settles into a new school year routine, Whole Grains Month is a great reminder that small choices can add up over time. Whether you’re trying a new recipe, involving the whole fam in meal preparation or gathering around the table together, every meal is an opportunity to build healthy habits and strengthen connections.
